name: wordle-legacy-mobile
description: Native Android wrapper for the legacy Wordle static site

scripts.copy:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R ../public/. www/
scripts.sync: npm run copy:web && cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
